def: Rule-based document filters on length, mean word length, symbol and stop-word ratios, punctuation and repeated lines or n-grams, such as the Gopher (MassiveText) and C4 rules.
practice: A cheap first pass before model-based filtering; FineWeb applies the Gopher quality and repetition filters and the C4 rules except terminal punctuation, which alone removed about 30% of tokens.
